name: Aidite Qinhuangdao Technology Co Ltd
summary: Aidite (Qinhuangdao) Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the research, development, production, and commercialization of advanced zirconia materials for dental applications. The company offers a comprehensive suite of dental solutions under its 'Cameo' brand. This extensive portfolio encompasses cutting-edge materials like Cameo 3D instant restorative zirconia and Cameo glass ceramics, alongside essential equipment. These include the Cameo intraoral scanner, the Cameo N4 and AV-D5 milling machines (with specialized systems for dry zirconia milling via the AV-D5 and wet glass ceramics milling via the N4), as well as Cameo fast sintering and glaze furnaces, providing a complete workflow for dental professionals. Established on March 15, 2007, by co-founders Hong Wen Li and Bin Li, the enterprise is headquartered in Qinhuangdao, China.
